svg.title: QueueSaathi — from spoken words to a clear doctor summary
svg.desc: Patient speaks; Prisma speech to text; Groq extraction; code validation; safety checks; doctor summary. Safety concerns branch to reception. Recorded evaluation: medicine names 52 to 95 percent with keyterms, four of four red flags caught, one false alarm in sixteen negative sessions.
svg.text: Speech in Hinglish → validated, evidence-backed summary for the doctor.
Small recorded test set · Alerts prompt staff review · Information collection, not diagnosis
